concerns.text: T001 requires the generator to emit a 'noise_feature' column AND requires test_extractor.py to 'assert schema conformance', but the schema declares 'additionalProperties: false'. As written the two requirements are mutually exclusive — the implementer cannot produce a CSV that both contains the control feature and validates. Either amend the schema to permit the declared control field or specify the control feature lives in a separate derived file with its own contract.

T007 requires a policy-head manifest 'per the data model' and an adapter_output.csv 'matching the AdapterModelOutput entity', and data-model.md declares contracts/policy_head.schema.yaml and contracts/adapter_output.schema.yaml — but neither contract file exists and no task creates them. T007's verification ('asserts the output CSV schema') has no schema to assert against; add a task (or extend T007) to author both contract files first.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Task format and paths vs plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: Plan places modules at 'src/generate/synthetic_dataset.py', 'tests/unit/test_extractor.py', spec dir 'specs/001-gui-topology-transfer/'; tasks use 'code/src/...', 'code/tests/...', 'specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-ui-mopd-mult/...'. An implementer following the plan's tree will produce files the tasks' commands and verification paths cannot find. Reconcile to one canonical layout (the tasks' 'code/' layout matches the constitution; update plan.md accordingly).

T001 is too coarse for deterministic execution: it bundles the synthetic generator, the FR-008 extractor (three distinct cleaning rules), two test files' worth of assertions, and quickstart documentation into one task. Split so the generator, the extractor, and the docs each have their own deliverable and verification.

Plan Phase 1 includes 'a-priori power note for detecting ΔAUC = 0.05 with three predictors under Bonferroni correction', but no task produces this artifact. Add a task naming the output file (e.g. data/results/power_analysis.md) and its verification, or drop the plan component.

T003's verification 'the documented command executes on the 2-core CPU runner within the 6-hour CI limit' names no observable check an implementer can run locally (no timing log, no CI workflow reference). Specify a measured artifact, e.g. wall-clock runtime recorded in first_e2e_metrics.json with a threshold assertion.

T011 has no concrete verification: 'a concise methods/results account' is not checkable. Name the file path unambiguously (choose research.md OR paper/research_notes.md, not 'or') and state how done is confirmed (e.g. every cited result file exists under data/results/ and every mentioned figure exists under figures/).

Plan's SSOT names 'data/derived/structural_records.csv' as the canonical derived file; T001 writes 'data/derived/structural_records_clean.csv'. Pick one canonical cleaned-output filename and use it consistently.
